theorems.name: Matched comparison well-posedness
theorems.statement: If candidate and donors do not share frozen task, information, tool, evaluator and resource contracts, no frontier-dominance terminal is defined.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Unmatched information lets an answer-bearing candidate appear superior.

theorems.name: Weak scientific dominance preorder
theorems.statement: Under one fixed comparison contract, donor conservativity, false-promotion non-amplification and componentwise resource noninferiority form a reflexive and transitive relation.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Incomparable resource dimensions prevent a total order but not a preorder.

theorems.name: Strict expansion preservation
theorems.statement: A conservative successor preserving a previous outside-closure witness also strictly expands the original donor family.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Deleting the witness or changing its contract defeats the theorem.

theorems.name: Finite frontier-dominance normal form
theorems.statement: On a finite frozen task class, matched contract plus empty conservativity/calibration/resource violation sets and a nonempty strict-frontier set is equivalent to frontier dominance.
assumptions: registered donor envelope complete for declared class
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: A frontier win with one old-task regression is rejected.

theorems.name: No scalar-free total superiority order
theorems.statement: Pareto-incomparable resource vectors cannot be ranked uniquely without an external price/preference vector.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: (1,10) versus (10,1) is incomparable.

theorems.name: Ideal donor-product first refusal
theorems.statement: Residual novelty relative to an expanded donor/product family cannot be larger when old explanations remain admissible.
assumptions: new donor family contains old explanations
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Replacing rather than extending the explanation family invalidates the premise.

theorems.name: Theorem-identifying superiority necessity
theorems.statement: If target and an alternative scientific claim have identical outcome signatures on frozen support, the harness cannot identify which explains a performance difference.
theorems.proof_or_reference_artifact: Discovery V1 harness-identifiability theorem; V3 integration
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Constant-positive or leaky harnesses may agree with both models.

theorems.name: Authority noninterference
theorems.statement: Computing frontier dominance or a nonempty residual does not grant external scientific validity, novelty, adoption or paper authority.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: A local boolean field cannot create an independent reviewer.

theorems.name: Collective interaction residual
theorems.statement: All component atoms may be donor-owned while an unabsorbed composition hyperedge remains a nonempty residual.
assumptions: donor covers every node but not every edge
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Two known methods connected by a new load-bearing bridge.

theorems.name: Triangulated frontier criterion
theorems.statement: Historical or in-sample frontier success alone does not establish transfer; the reference strong terminal additionally requires held-out and counterfactual strict wins, with prospective and external authority remaining separate.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Memorized historical answer passes history but fails a reminted twin.

theorems.name: Donor-expansion residual monotonicity
theorems.statement: Adding admissible donor explanations cannot increase every minimal semantic residual.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Dropping an old explanation is not donor expansion.

theorems.name: Semantic-isomorphism invariance
theorems.statement: Layer- and relation-preserving renaming transports the residual family isomorphically.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Surface renaming with changed relations is not an isomorphism.

theorems.name: Interaction novelty theorem
theorems.statement: Zero residual nodes do not imply zero residual edges.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: All nodes covered, composition edge uncovered.

theorems.name: Residual-value separation
theorems.statement: A nonempty semantic residual does not imply a useful discovery unless it changes a hidden consequence, target obligation or verified reach.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Decorative unused operator has nonempty syntax and zero scientific effect.

theorems.name: Set-valued residual necessity
theorems.statement: Incomparable donor explanations can produce multiple inclusion-minimal residuals; choosing one without a target criterion is unjustified.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Donor A covers atom a; donor B covers atom b.

theorems.name: Residual subadditivity with bridge term
theorems.statement: The minimal residual of a composition is bounded by component residuals plus unabsorbed bridge structure.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Omitting the bridge term fails for interaction-only novelty.

theorems.name: No finite universal discovery morphology
theorems.statement: For every fixed finite move language there exists a registered target requiring a primitive outside its closure.
assumptions: target languages may add a fresh primitive
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Diagonal fresh-primitive target.

theorems.name: Fair-dovetail relative completeness
theorems.statement: Diagonal scheduling eventually visits every finite generator/program-index pair.
assumptions: terminating candidate verifier for positive witness
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: A useful move absent from all generators remains unreachable.

theorems.name: Pareto identifying-portfolio completeness
theorems.statement: Finite exhaustive subset search returns exactly the nondominated experiment portfolios covering every registered alternative pair.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: A cheaper non-identifying experiment is correctly excluded.

theorems.name: Explicit scalarization law
theorems.statement: A unique minimum-cost experiment is licensed only by a complete nonnegative price vector supplied independently of outcomes.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Omitting memory price raises an error rather than silently treating memory as free.

theorems.name: No-man’s-land certificate soundness
theorems.statement: Within a declared closure/verifier class, a certificate with old-closure exhaustion, unsupplied origin, nonempty load-bearing residual, hidden consequence, transfer, donor first refusal and independent validity supports bounded outside-closure discovery candidacy.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: Any omitted premise has a supplied, donor-absorbed, inert or invalid countermodel.

theorems.name: Minimal load-bearing superiority witness
theorems.statement: Given independently executed residual-deletion mutations, the inclusion-minimal removed atom sets that destroy every strict frontier win are exactly the minimal causal witness candidates registered by the mutation family.
theorems.smallest_boundary_or_counterexample: No single deletion need be sufficient when two residual atoms are jointly load-bearing.
